analogy.rationale: DNA alkylating agents covalently modify DNA, producing DNA damage and replication stress; other DNA-targeting classes (methyltransferase, polymerase, synthesis, topoisomerase inhibitors) converge on similar DNA damage/repair and cell-cycle arrest programs, while the annotated CYP/MGMT targets reflect metabolism rather than the primary mechanism.
